NBA DFS Value Plays for Wednesday, November 18 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Wednesday, November 18 · 9 games · First game 7:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 18, 6:06 PM ET

Immanuel Quickley (TOR) is the top value on the Wednesday, November 18 DraftKings main slate: 42.6 projected points for $6,800, or 6.26 points per $1,000. Kevin Huerter (DET, 6.24) and Daniss Jenkins (DET, 6.11) are next.

Value here is projected DraftKings points per $1,000 of salary, among players the SPAGS model projects for at least 20 points. A cheap player with a small projection is not a value play by this measure.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 18, 6:06 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use the board

Value frees salary for the expensive players you want. It does not make a player a good play by itself: a low salary often reflects a real doubt about his minutes. When a starter is ruled out, the players who take his minutes are usually the best values on the slate, and they appear here only after the numbers are run again.

NBA DFS value plays FAQ for Nov 18

Who are the top NBA DFS value plays for Wednesday, November 18?

Immanuel Quickley (TOR) at 6.26 projected points per $1,000 for $6,800, Kevin Huerter (DET) at 6.24 projected points per $1,000 for $4,900 and Daniss Jenkins (DET) at 6.11 projected points per $1,000 for $6,200 lead the DraftKings main slate by SPAGS projection per dollar, as of November 18, 6:06 PM ET.

What counts as an NBA DFS value play?

A player whose projected DraftKings points are high for his salary. This board ranks projected points per $1,000 among players projected for at least 20 points.
